name: wordpress-devops
description: Operate authorized WordPress hosting, runtime, plugin lifecycle, filesystem, and deployment infrastructure through Railway or DigitalOcean and SSH.

interface.shortDescription: Operate WordPress hosting and runtime infrastructure safely.
interface.longDescription: A DevOps-only WordPress workflow for Railway or DigitalOcean target resolution, authorized SSH, WP-CLI runtime diagnosis, plugin and theme lifecycle, filesystem ownership, hosting configuration, deployment, rollback, and infrastructure-as-code commits. It does not edit pages, posts, media, videos, or user-facing design content.
defaultPrompt: Onboard WordPress DevOps with a Railway or DigitalOcean target and SSH access, read-only.
Diagnose my WordPress plugin or filesystem issue without changing the server.
Plan an infrastructure-backed WordPress runtime change and its commit and rollback.
